Load a bisonR model saved with bison_save()

Source: R/saveload_bisonobj.R
bison_load.Rd

Reads a fitted model saved with bison_save(), so it can be used in a new R session in the same way as a newly fitted model. Models saved with earlier versions of bisonR (0.4.x), which kept the Stan fit in a separate file, are also read.

Usage

bison_load(file)

Arguments

file

Path of an .rds file written by bison_save(). .rds is appended if the file isn't found without it.

Value

The fitted model object.

See also

bison_save()

Examples

sim_data <- simulate_bison_model("binary", aggregated = TRUE)
fit_edge <- bison_model(
  (event | effort) ~ dyad(node_1_id, node_2_id),
  data = sim_data$df_sim,
  model_type = "binary_conjugate",
  priors = get_default_priors("binary_conjugate")
)
path <- tempfile(fileext = ".rds")
bison_save(fit_edge, path)
fit_reloaded <- bison_load(path)
